purpose: Build implied unit-economics proxies from official revenue and shipment/volume fields where product-level ASP is unavailable.

records.metric: Official unit selling price and unit cost from inquiry response
records.interpretation: Nanya provides the cleanest official unit-price proxy. It is still company-wide CCL/prepreg, not M8/M9/M10 ASP.

records.metric: Segment revenue divided by reported CCL / prepreg sales volume
records.interpretation: This is a crude scale proxy because the segment combines CCL and prepreg. It should not be interpreted as product ASP.

records.metric: CCL revenue divided by reported CCL sales volume
